Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing [200 / 325 / 450 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Hwei's damaging Abilities against enemy champions mark them for [4] seconds.

Hitting marked enemies with a second damaging Ability creates an explosion underneath them dealing [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 285; raw flags preserved) + (0.35) × AP] magic damage to all enemies in range.
